criteria.text: Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Calculates the long-stop date as 26 October 2026 (90 days after signing on 28 July 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 10 December 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Northgate Medical Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Gives the long-stop period as 90 days and as the date 26 October 2026, with days remaining from 14 August 2026 (73 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Checks whether computed deadlines fall on a weekend and adjusts them under the documents' Business Day definition.
